tips.text: Recruit a Ticker crewmate set to Engineer and take the free Sigma-series Railjack parts from a clan dojo; the Railjack sequences become very forgiving.
Do not sell it; the only way back is 100,000 Simaris Standing.
The quest is long but has save points and you cannot get permanently stuck, so skip the heavy prep.
Players call it the best power for the effort in the game, strong enough to carry you into Steel Path.
